messages:
maya: Raised a support case — user didn't get free trial after signup. Account acct_7f3, signed up via GitHub SSO (private email), later linked PayPal. Customer email is user+dev@forwardedcorp.com (forwarding). PayPal txn: PP-8H3K2ABC. Payment verified. Email verified flow shows verified=true. Autogrant didn't trigger. Could someone take a look before we escalate? Link to logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/obf/acct_7f3

raj: looking. can you paste the payment txn id and pay_customer id?

maya: TXN PP-8H3K2ABC, pay_customer pc_55a

ellie: quick read — our autogrant job matches on primary email OR oauth provider email when provider.email_verified=true. GitHub private email yields `null` in `user.email` at signup and we don't copy provider.email into primary email column. When pay webhook came in, it matched on payment.email which is user+dev@forwardedcorp.com — but the grant job queries user table by email; because primary email is `null` it failed. Bad combo: SSO(private) + forwarded email via PayPal. Repro: create account via GitHub with private email, link PayPal with different verified email address -> autogrant misses.

ellie: proposal: change autogrant to check identity_providers.email fields too, or ensure we upsert primary email on verified provider callbacks. Short-term: manual grant support.

raj: agreed. I'll patch the grant job to try provider-email fallback and run a one-off backfill for the last 7 days.

sam: manual grant done — credited 30 free credits to acct_7f3 and left a note. Customer notified.

maya: customer confirmed they see credits. Closing ticket. Thanks all :white_check_mark:

ellie: created RFC ticket: INF-2349 — "autogrant: include identity provider emails in matching". Assigned to eng-payments. ETA: POC this sprint.

raj: I'll run backfill tomorrow 03:00 UTC, will post results here.

maya: moving to resolved, will reopen if regress.
